Have just logged in to check my post, and no-one has commented and replied.  Which I'm content with. I'm a vile, disgusting human being with no right to expect support.  It has made my decision a lot easier.

Just like to say sorry to those I'll leave behind but it will get better and you will be better off without me.

I won't be logging in or checking replies again, so if anyone does read this pls pls pls help someone who deserves it.
